Blocks.Text: The Organization Commitment API returns commitment data for organizations (companies, schools, and showcase pages) on LinkedIn. Commitments represent values and causes that organizations publicly support and demonstrate through their actions. Ex: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI).

Commitments are displayed on organization LinkedIn pages under the About section, where companies showcase their dedication to specific values and causes.
Examples:

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)
Environmental Sustainability
Career Growth and Learning
Work-Life Balance
Social Impact
Organizations can provide evidence of their commitments through:

Featured credentials (reports or pledges)
Third-party certifications (e.g., B Corp membership)
Resources (articles, blog posts, videos)
Perks and benefits offered to employees
Internal programs (e.g., mentorship programs)
This feature has been known by different names across LinkedIn:

Organization Commitments (current name)
Featured Commitments (taxonomy reference)
Company Values (informal reference)
This API does not share member personal data as part of the API response.
The service currently provides the following methods:

Get a single organization's commitment for a given organization commitment URN.
Batch Get commitments for the set of organization commitment urns.
Organization find all commitments for a given organization
To query organization commitment data, the authenticated user must have one of the following roles on the organization page:

ADMINISTRATOR
CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR
Step 1: Get Organizations You Can Query
Before querying commitment data, you need to identify which organizations you have permissions to access. Use the OrganizationAuthorization API's BATCH_FIND method:

GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/dmaOrganizationAuthorization?q=authorizationActionAndAuthenticatedMember&authorizationAction=(organizationProfileAuthorizationAction:(actionType:ORGANIZATION_PROFILE_WRITE))
This returns a list of organization URNs you have access to. For more information, refer to Organization Authorization .
Step 2: Query Commitments for Your Organization
Once you have an organization URN (e.g., urn:li:organization:1234), you can:
Option A: Find all commitments for an organization
GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/dmaOrganizationCommitment?q=organization&organization=urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A1234
Option B: Get specific commitment by URN
If you have a specific organization commitment URN (e.g., urn:li:organizationCommitment:(urn:li:organization:1234,5)):
GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/dmaOrganizationCommitment/urn%3Ali%3AorganizationCommitment%3A%28urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A1234%2C5%29
Step 3: Resolve Commitment Names

The API response includes commitment IDs. To get human-readable commitment names (like "Diversity, Equity & Inclusion"), extract the commitment ID from the URN and call the Featured Commitment Taxonomy API:
GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/dmaFeaturedCommitmentTaxonomyVersions/V1_0/dmaFeaturedCommitment/{COMMITMENT_ID}?locale=(language:en,country:US)
See Featured Commitment Taxonomy for details.
Step 4: Resolve Benefits (if applicable)
If the commitment response includes perksAndBenefits URNs, resolve them using the Benefits Taxonomy API:
GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/dmaBenefitTaxonomyVersions/V1_0/dmaBenefit/{BENEFIT_ID}?locale=(language:en,country:US)

Rows.Text: Unique identifier for a commitment of an organization.

Indicates if this commitment is active. When active is true, commitment is visible in the member view, which means a LinkedIn member is able to see the commitments on a organization's page. When active is false, commitment is hidden from the member view. (In admin view, commitments are editable. In member view, it is read only.)
Featured credential (report or pledge) is a proof for commitment. External or internal URL is supported. Organizations can present either report or pledge as a proof (whichever available, not both)

Certification and pledges are proof for commitment. External or internal URLs supported. Ex: Third party credentials such as B Corp membership indicating proof of the commitment 'Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)'.

Resources are proof for commitment. External or internal URLs supported. Ex: articles, blog posts, organization pages, videos, podcasts,etc indicating proofs to the commitment 'Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)'.
Array of perks and benefits are proof for commitment. Subset of the existing benefits taxonomy. Ex: Work from home benefit indicating the proof to the commitment 'Work Life Balance'.
Programs (comma separated text) are proof for commitment. Ex: Details about Quarterly Mentorship Program, Internal Rotation ...etc indicating proofs to the commitment 'Career Growth and Learning'.
Order in which to display the commitment. It is internally inferred/mapped number used for commitments display order
Indicates whether a commitment is measured as quality by current Data Science definitions.

Blocks.Text:
An organizationCommitmentUrn is a composite URN constructed using the commitment ID and the URN of the organization this commitment belongs to.
For example, a commitment with an ID of 5 for organization URN urn:li:organization:1234 would look like urn:li:organizationCommitment:(urn:li:organization:1234,5).

To get commitments data like name, description etc call partnerApiDmaFeaturedCommitment endpoint with relevant commitment ID.
Commitment ID can be extracted from OrganizationCommitmentUrn (see example above).
To get benefits data like name, description etc call partnerApiDmaBenefits endpoint with relevant benefit ID extracted from BenefitUrn.
Tip

How to determine which organizational pages you can query:
To find the organizations you can query {{resource, plural}} for, please use OrganizationAuthorization’s BATCH_FIND by AuthorizationAction and AuthenticatedMember with an authorization action of OrganizationProfileAuthorizationActionType.ORGANIZATION_PROFILE_WRITE.
Note
Ensure that {ORGANIZATION_URN} must be URL-encoded.
An organizationCommitmentUrn is a composite URN constructed using a commitment ID (can be extracted from FeaturedCommitmentUrn) and an organizationUrn.

http


curl
GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/dmaOrganizationCommitment/{ORGANIZATION_COMMITMENT_URN}

curl -X GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/dmaOrganizationCommitment/dmaOrganizationCommitment/urn%3Ali%3AorganizationCommitment%3A%28urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A1234%2C5%29' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}' \
--header 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \
--header 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0'
